Battle of Wagram.subject: World Geography

Battle of Wagram.subject: World Geography
Battle of Wagram.question: He was much surprised to receive reports that the village was completely undefended and, after making sure that it was not a trap, _____ immediately ordered his vanguard to occupy it
Battle of Wagram.fact: He had begun his manoeuvre just after 03:00, moving south, out of his position along the Russbach line and at Deutsch-Wagram, Bellegarde formed a vanguard of three battalions and three squadrons, under the command of General-Major Stutterheim, which he sent towards Aderklaa. Battle of Wagram.subject: World Geography

Battle of Wagram.subject: World Geography

Battle of Wagram.fact: The task of defending Aderklaa belonged to Maréchal Bernadotte, commander of the Saxon IX Corps. With his infantry reduced to some 6,000 men, the commander had difficulties rallying a part of his troop but he could still count on two reasonably valid Saxon divisions.

Battle of Wagram.subject: World Geography

Battle of Wagram.subject: World Geography
